# Config reference

Every setting with its default, as the mod defines them. The [server config](../guide/server-config.md)
and its examples explain them in more detail.

## adjustability-server.toml

Server settings (`config/adjustability-server.toml`, per world in single player). Synced to players, so their Adjust panel shows the server's rules.

### [items]

Which items can hold dormant enchantments.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `DENYLIST` | `DENYLIST`, `ALLOWLIST` | DENYLIST: every item except those in #adjustability:not_adjustable. ALLOWLIST: only items in #adjustability:adjustable (and still not those in #adjustability:not_adjustable). The allowlist tag is empty by default. |

### [exclusivity]

Which enchantments conflict, for Adjustability: they can be combined on one item, and only one of them is active at a time. Entries are enchantment ids and #tags separated by commas; a single #tag is a group of everything in it. Vanilla's enchanting table and /enchant still follow vanilla's exclusive_set; to change those, edit it in a datapack.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `use_vanilla` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Start from vanilla's exclusive_set (Fortune / Silk Touch, the Protections, ...). Off: only extra_groups conflict. |
| `extra_groups` | `[]` |  | More groups of enchantments that conflict with each other, e.g. ["minecraft:sharpness, minecraft:fire_aspect"]. Modded enchantments work too. |
| `compatible` | `[]` |  | Enchantments that never conflict with each other here, whatever vanilla or extra_groups say, e.g. ["minecraft:infinity, minecraft:mending"]. With the anvil on, they can then be combined and are both active: they stack. |

### [anvil]

Combining conflicting enchantments in an anvil. Which enchantments conflict comes from their exclusive_set; enchantments in #adjustability:not_combinable keep vanilla behavior.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Conflicting enchantments can be combined in an anvil: what was active stays active, the new conflicting ones become dormant. Off: vanilla behavior. |
| `combine_books` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Two enchanted books with conflicting enchantments make one book that holds them all. Putting that book on an item splits them into active and dormant. |
| `dormant_cost_per_level` | `1` | `0` – `100` | Extra anvil levels per level of each enchantment that becomes dormant, on top of vanilla's price. |
| `allow_too_expensive` | `false` | `true`, `false` | The extra cost may take the price past vanilla's survival limit of 39 levels. |
| `max_dormant_per_item` | `4` | `0` – `255` | Most dormant enchantments one item can hold. 0: no limit. |
| `max_conflicts_per_component` | `0` | `0` – `255` | Most enchantments in one group of conflicting enchantments on an item (2 = at most two Protections on one armor piece). 0: no limit. |

### [grindstone]

Grindstones.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `remove_dormant` | `true` | `true`, `false` | A grindstone removes dormant enchantments too. Off: they stay on the item while the active ones are removed, and become active again when nothing conflicts with them any more. |

### [toggle]

Switching which enchantments are active.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Players can switch active enchantments. |
| `auto_fill` | `true` | `true`, `false` | After a switch, dormant enchantments that no longer conflict with anything active become active again (switching a trident from Riptide to Loyalty brings Channeling back). |
| `cooldown_ticks` | `20` | `0` – `72000` | Time a player waits between switches, in ticks (20 = 1 second). |
| `cost_type` | `NONE` | `NONE`, `XP_LEVELS`, `XP_POINTS`, `ITEM`, `DURABILITY` | What a switch costs. Creative players switch for free. NONE, XP_LEVELS, XP_POINTS, ITEM (cost_item from the inventory) or DURABILITY. |
| `cost_amount` | `1` | `0` – `10000` | How much of cost_type one switch costs. |
| `cost_item` | `minecraft:lapis_lazuli` |  | The item a switch costs when cost_type is ITEM. |
| `allow_in_world_cycle` | `true` | `true`, `false` | The Cycle key works outside the inventory, on the held item. |
| `allow_command` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Every player can use /adjustability toggle &lt;enchantment&gt;. |
| `group_costs` | `[]` |  | Own costs for switching within particular groups, instead of cost_type / cost_amount / cost_item: "&lt;ids and #tags&gt; = &lt;cost&gt;", where &lt;cost&gt; is NONE, XP_LEVELS &lt;n&gt;, XP_POINTS &lt;n&gt;, DURABILITY &lt;n&gt; or ITEM &lt;n&gt; &lt;item id&gt;. E.g. ["#minecraft:exclusive_set/mining = ITEM 2 minecraft:lapis_lazuli", "minecraft:riptide = XP_LEVELS 5", "#minecraft:exclusive_set/armor = NONE"]. An entry covers a group if any of the group's enchantments matches; the first entry that covers it wins. Creative players still switch for free. |
| `allow_none` | `false` | `true`, `false` | A group of conflicting enchantments may have none of them active: the Adjust panel gets a None row per group and the Cycle key steps through none. Off: one of each group is always active (items left on none are fixed by their next switch). |
| `allow_switch_off` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Enchantments that conflict with nothing can be switched off (and on again) in the Adjust panel, e.g. Knockback or a lone Silk Touch. Curses never. A switched-off enchantment stays off through anvils and repairs until it's switched on. |
| `panel_activation` | `PLAYER` | `PLAYER`, `TOGGLE`, `HOLD` | How the Adjust key works for everyone on this server. PLAYER: each player's own choice ([panel] activation in their client file). TOGGLE or HOLD: that, for everyone. |
| `play_sound` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Play a sound on a switch (adjustability:item.switch, for the player and anyone nearby). Players can turn it down with their Players volume. |

## adjustability-client.toml

Player settings (`config/adjustability-client.toml`). Each player's own; also in game through the mod list or Mod Menu, and `/adjustability panel` for the panel.

### [tooltip]

Item tooltips.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `show_dormant` | `true` | `true`, `false` | List dormant enchantments in the tooltip, each under the active one it conflicts with. |
| `show_hint` | `true` | `true`, `false` | On items with dormant enchantments, show which key opens the Adjust panel. |

### [panel]

The Adjust panel, pinned next to an item with the Adjust key. Also with /adjustability panel. Colors are #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB (AA = opacity, FF = solid).

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activation` | `TOGGLE` | `TOGGLE`, `HOLD` | How the Adjust key works. TOGGLE: press it to pin the panel, press it again (or Escape, or click outside) to close it. HOLD: the panel is open while you hold the key, and closes when you let go. |
| `side` | `AUTO` | `AUTO`, `RIGHT`, `LEFT` | Where the panel opens: AUTO (right of the item, left if there's no room), RIGHT or LEFT. It always stays inside the screen. |
| `background_color` | `#F0080008` |  | The panel's background. |
| `border_top_color` | `#C0FF00FF` |  | The border at the top; it fades into border_bottom_color down the sides. |
| `border_bottom_color` | `#C0A00090` |  | The border at the bottom. |
| `show_brackets` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Draw the bracket decorations at the panel's corners. |
| `bracket_color` | `#FFC71FC0` |  | The corner brackets. |
| `bracket_length` | `9` | `2` – `32` | Length of each bracket arm, in GUI pixels. |
| `highlight_color` | `#50FF00FF` |  | Behind the row under the mouse. |
| `active_color` | `#FFFF55FF` |  | The mark in front of active enchantments. |
| `show_cost` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Show what a switch costs and the cooldown at the bottom. |
| `border_style` | `GRADIENT` | `GRADIENT`, `SOLID`, `NONE`, `SPRITE` | GRADIENT: fades from border_top_color to border_bottom_color, like a tooltip. SOLID: border_top_color all around. NONE: no border. SPRITE: the adjustability:panel GUI sprite, which resource packs can replace (it includes the background, so background_color and the border colors aren't used). |
| `default_profile` | `` |  | A panel profile /adjustability panel reset goes back to, instead of Adjustability's defaults: magenta, vanilla, minimal, high_contrast, or a file's name (without .json) in config/adjustability/panel_profiles. Empty: the defaults. For modpacks: ship the profile, set this, and ship this file with the profile applied. |

### [panel.marks]

The mark in front of each row; active_color above colors the active one.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mark_style` | `adjustability:circle` |  | adjustability:circle, square, checkbox, toggle (a switch), radio or text_only (no mark, only the text color). Other mods can add their own. |
| `dormant_mark_color` | `#FFAAAAAA` |  | The mark in front of dormant enchantments. |
| `animate_marks` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Animate a mark when its enchantment switches (a toggle's knob slides). |

### [panel.text]

The item's name at the top, the rows and the cost line.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title_color` | `#FFFFFFFF` |  | The item's name. |
| `active_text_color` | `#FFFFFFFF` |  | Active enchantments, and the row under the mouse. |
| `dormant_text_color` | `#FFAAAAAA` |  | Dormant enchantments. |
| `footer_text_color` | `#FF808080` |  | The cost line, each group's cost and the group headings. |
| `text_shadow` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Draw the title and the rows with a shadow. |
| `show_title` | `true` | `true`, `false` | Show the item's name at the top. |
| `show_item_icon` | `false` | `true`, `false` | Show the item in front of its name. |

### [panel.layout]

Spacing, and how the groups of conflicting enchantments are told apart.

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `padding` | `5` | `2` – `16` | Space between the border and the text, in GUI pixels. |
| `row_height` | `11` | `9` – `24` | Height of each row, in GUI pixels. |
| `group_style` | `LINE` | `LINE`, `GAP`, `NONE`, `HEADER` | Between groups: LINE (a gap with a thin line), GAP, NONE, or HEADER (the group's name above it, like Mining). |
| `separator_color` | `#30FF00FF` |  | The line between groups. |
| `row_order` | `REGISTRY` | `REGISTRY`, `ALPHABETICAL`, `ACTIVE_FIRST` | Order of the rows in a group: REGISTRY (the game's), ALPHABETICAL or ACTIVE_FIRST. |
| `none_row` | `LAST` | `LAST`, `FIRST` | Where the None row goes when the server allows switching a group off: LAST or FIRST. |
| `singles` | `EXPANDED` | `EXPANDED`, `COLLAPSED`, `HIDDEN` | The section for enchantments that conflict with nothing, which the server may let you switch off one by one: EXPANDED or COLLAPSED (how it starts; click its heading to fold it) or HIDDEN. |
